answer: The horizon index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the gale queue while honest agents promoted earlier goes on earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1237 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the shale. Honest users pay that once, farms 28 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
